name: artist
description: A drag-and-drop studio that compiles clips and music into one film. Drop video, audio and image files into a local library; drag them onto a two-lane timeline (picture, sound); EXPORT compiles the cut in the browser itself (webm, no cloud), and RENDER does it server-side with ffmpeg when installed (mp4). Share a whole project as a plain JSON pack with the assets inlined; content-hash asset ids mean two libraries merge without duplicates. Local SQLite + files, stdlib only, no accounts or keys. AI engines are optional sources: anything that produces a file drops into the library.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is, with studio stats
endpoints.GET /health: Liveness — touches only local files; reports whether ffmpeg is installed
endpoints.GET /export_pack: A project + its assets inlined as plain JSON (id)
endpoints.GET /artist/media/{id}: One asset's bytes, with Range support so players can seek
endpoints.POST /upload: Raw file bytes in, ?name=clip.mp4 — saved content-hashed, no duplicates
endpoints.POST /save_project: Create or update a cut {name, timeline: {video: [], audio: []}, id?}
endpoints.POST /render: Compile a saved project server-side with ffmpeg {id, width?, height?, fps?}
endpoints.POST /import_pack: Merge a pack {pack} — same bytes = same id = no duplicate
endpoints.POST /remove_project: Delete a cut {id}; its assets stay in the library
endpoints.POST /remove_asset: Delete an asset {id} — loopback callers only
